text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, amazing...! We planted all the 
vegetable seedlings so neatly!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can't wait for the vegetables to 
grow! I want to eat them soon...

Hearing her say "I can't wait to eat them" 
makes me think. What we planted this time 
are mainly summer vegetables... It'll be 
quite a while before they're ready to 
harvest.

Then it suddenly hit me... That's right, 
there are seasonal spring flavors you can 
only enjoy right now!
choice_data_list:
(The one that grows wild on its own 
without being planted—that's it!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found it, Onii-sama! Isn't that the 
one growing over there?
choice_data_list: You're right, it's warabi, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found it, Onee-sama! Isn't that the 
one growing over there?
choice_data_list: You're right, it's warabi, isn't it!

text_block_list.text:
A few days later. We were enjoying some 
wild edible plant foraging on a mountain 
owned by Chairwoman Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. So this is how wild vegetables grow! 
It's kind of like treasure hunting.

According to the caretaker, this mountain 
is very bountiful. Even being mindful not 
to over-harvest, it seems one can still 
gather a generous amount and variety of 
wild vegetables.
choice_data_list:
I wonder what kind of wild vegetable set 
meal I should make.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, are you really going to cook 
for me? Wah, I can't wait...! ...I have to 
do my best and pick a lot, then!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, are you really going to cook 
for me? Waah, I'm so excited...! ...I've 
got to do my best and gather a lot, then!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Rice... Hang in there, oh-!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The fuzzy one is Mr. Bracken, and the 
smooth one is Mr. Ostrich Fern, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is that... Kogomi-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So this is the "King of Wild Vegetables," 
angelica tree shoots...! They really are 
all prickly...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what it tastes like... I can't 
wait to try it.

Wild mountain greens generally have a 
distinct flavor, and some people find them 
hard to stomach.

"Still, seeing how excited she is for it, 
it's so nutritious that I really want her 
to like it."
choice_data_list:
(Alright, time to put my all into making 
this!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We have warabi mixed rice, various wild 
vegetable tempura, Chinese-style stir-fry, 
simmered dishes, ohitashi, tossed salads, 
suiton dumplings...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Over here we have sandwiches, ajillo, 
pizza, gratin, pot-au-feu, and salad...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I got a little too eager...!

text_block_list.text:
"I definitely wanted Rice Shower to like 
it. I put so much effort into it that I 
ended up making an unbelievable mountain 
of food."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"No! Thank you for so much, Onii-sama! 
...May I try some?"
choice_data_list:
Of course! ...Just don't push yourself too 
hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"No! Thank you for so much, Onee-sama! 
...May I try some?"
choice_data_list:
Of course! ...Just don't push yourself too 
hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Well then, I'll start with the 
seasoned rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *nom*!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Delithious...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Warabi has a bit of a crunchy bite to it, 
doesn't it? The dashi soaked in so well, 
it's such a gentle flavor...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll go with this sandwich next. 
Which wild greens are in this one?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Watercress-san...! These are the ones 
picked near the river.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *Nom!*

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: This is super, super delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's a little spicy and bitter... but that 
goes so well with the honey mustard and 
chicken tenders...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to learn how to make them too. 
That way, she can eat them every morning!
choice_data_list:
Don't you get tired of sandwiches every 
morning?

Do you ever get tired of sandwiches every 
morning?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"No! ...Rice loves rice, of course, but 
for breakfast, I'm strictly a bread 
person."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"So having sandwiches every morning is 
totally fine! ...In fact, if it's these 
sandwiches, I'd be in heaven!"

Having finished her sandwich with those 
words, Rice Shower continued to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *Chomp!*

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *Slurp!*

I knew she ate a lot for her small frame, 
but I never expected it to be quite this 
much.
choice_data_list: Did you do "eating training" or something?
Did you do "eating training" or something?

text_block_list.text:
Athletes sometimes undergo "eating 
training" to increase their food intake. I 
thought that might be the case for her 
petite frame, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ? ...No, never have. Just—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Rice eats a lot, Mother and 
everyone look so happy. ...Wearing the 
smile Rice loves so much.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Is it tasty, Rice-chan? ...Oh, really! 
I'm so glad~"

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Good job eating so much, Rice. Look, 
you've got some rice on your face."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice was really small as a baby. So 
whenever I eat a lot, it puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Your expression was so gentle, I loved it 
so much. I just couldn't help eating a 
ton...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And if that happens, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just... just a little bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I became a little too much of a glutton.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... Rice can't do that anymore. I'm 
making my debut, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Butterbur-san's tempura, too... M-Must 
resist, must resist...!

You have to consider balance, of course, 
but being able to eat a lot is great for 
building a sturdy body to fight through 
races.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I see! Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then Rice will keep eating lots and 
getting super strong from now on...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Time to eat, Butterbur-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: !!!! B-Bitter...!
